checks.scopeNote: Four unit and two process tests, also included in the final CLI cohort

notes: New gateway export-partial pins run/revision/session/turn/status/length/SHA and one connection epoch while collecting at most 4 MiB and 4096 contiguous pages under the existing overall network deadline
Only operator.read and agent.wait are used; no ACK, automatic retry/reconnect, write idempotency or cursor/wait overrides are accepted
All pages and the complete SHA256 are verified before preparing a local write; an empty retained partial may export, while an unavailable partial fails

The writer reuses pinned parent and Sandbox create_new_file, refuses overwrite/links, syncs and checks the directory, and is joined once started; Unix files are owner-only and Windows inherits the trusted parent ACL
This is not atomic rename publication: local I/O failure can leave an output file and is reported through fileMayExist; failed network/page validation creates no output
Receipt metadata never includes exported text, reasoning, tool arguments or the stdin credential; the local file is explicitly untrusted incomplete plaintext and grants no execution authority
Seven real CLI subprocess/WebSocket fixture modes cover valid, empty, full-hash corruption, identity change, disconnect, existing target and absence; no daemon paging protocol was changed

Initial unit compile failures because DiagnosticFailure has no Debug were resolved with explicit result matching rather than adding Debug; failures are in terminal conversation history, not separate logs
No public API outside CLI was changed; final all-target CLI tests and lint are the scoped gates, not a new root-workspace build claim
All earlier credential/MCP/OAuth/stdio anomalies remain unresolved; no dependency/lock, production/proxy, real account/browser/device migration, deployment or Git write occurred
unverified: Atomic rename publication or injected low-level disk-write/sync failures for plaintext export; unconfirmed local files are explicitly preserved
Encrypted partial-export format, interrupted-export resumption, TUI/desktop partial UX and continuous source partial-text checkpoints
Actual CLI export against a real provider account and all operating systems; daemon owner-bound page evidence is from prior separate checkpoints
All prior native credential/MCP/stdio root causes, complete frozen build manifests, release and whole-project acceptance
